name: data-analysis-report
description: Generate comprehensive data analysis reports from Excel files using LLM-powered insights with enhanced eval framework and agent-based testing
author: data-analysis-webui
abstract: Automatically analyze Excel data and generate comprehensive Word reports with charts, statistics, and AI-powered insights. Now follows skill-creator best practices with comprehensive eval framework, agent-based testing, modular structure, and progressive documentation. Supports offline deployment with Ollama/vLLM models. Features automatic Excel structure detection, natural language time window parsing, metric disambiguation, statistical analysis (trends, percentiles, outliers, correlations), and professional Word document generation with time-series charts and AI-written insights.
capabilities: Excel file parsing with automatic date and metric column detection
Natural language request processing using LLM
Metric disambiguation for similar column names
Time window resolution (relative and absolute dates)
Statistical analysis (mean, min, max, median, std, percentiles, outliers, drift)
Time-series chart generation with trend lines
Comprehensive test suite with evals.json schema
requirements: Ollama or vLLM service (for LLM capabilities)
FastAPI server running on configured port
Excel file with date column and numeric metrics

key_files.SKILL.md: Main skill documentation with optimized triggering

improvements_in_v3: Added evals/ directory with comprehensive test cases
Added agents/ directory with grader.md for evaluation
Optimized description for better triggering (skill-creator pattern)
references: skill-creator reference structure for best practices
